lines.text: Many learners say: By my opinion, this movie is good.
Better: In my opinion, this movie is good.
In! In my opinion, it is good.

data.wrong: By my opinion, this movie is good.
data.right: In my opinion, this movie is good.

native.tip: Говори “in my opinion”: “In my opinion, this movie is good.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “By my opinion, this movie is good”? 😅 Русское «по моему мнению» легко превратить в “by”, но по-английски говорят “in.” Правильно: “In my opinion, this movie is good.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “in.” Говорят in my opinion. Напиши своё предложение с “In my opinion.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Say “in my opinion”: “In my opinion, this movie is good.”
en.caption: Do you also say “By my opinion, this movie is good”? 😅 The Russian phrase is easy to copy as “by,” but English says “in.” Correct: “In my opinion, this movie is good.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
